That history of smoking and factory exposure, combined with your spirometry showing an FEV1/FVC ratio of 0.61 and the chest X-ray signs of hyperinflation, is classic for COPD. DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) exacerbation in a patient with known Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy.
